An [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] was a '''member''' of the secretive [[Star Cabal]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and attended a meeting aboard the [[Star Chamber (space station)|''Star Chamber'']] in person in [[3640 BBY]].
